description.en: Headless rich text editor components for React, built on Tiptap and shadcn.
description.zh: 基于 Tiptap 与 shadcn 打造的无头高扩展性 React 富文本编辑器组件库。

content.en: editorcn delivers an elegant, Notion-style rich text editing experience engineered with Tiptap and shadcn/ui. Featuring slash commands, floating bubble menus, markdown shortcuts, code block syntax highlighting, and image drag-and-drop, it gives apps a modern publishing interface.
content.zh: editorcn 是一套深度融合 Tiptap 富文本核心与 shadcn 交互规范的模块化现代编辑器。具备类 Notion 的斜杠命令菜单（Slash Command）、划词悬浮格式栏、Markdown 快捷输入、代码高亮与图片拖拽上传，能无缝嵌入笔记与知识库类产品。
